answer: Randomized Reef Assignment. Each epoch, a public verifiable-randomness beacon assigns every registered identity to a random shard; agents must submit work only within their assigned shard, and shards reshuffle unpredictably each round. An attacker farming many identities cannot precompute which shard each will occupy, so any vine of coordinated accounts is scattered before it can act.
